name: shopping-assistant-service
description: LLM proxy for the Akamai Store shopping assistant

scripts.build: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://shopping-assistant-service.localhost -o dist/shopping-assistant-service.wasm
scripts.build:debug: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -d -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://shopping-assistant-service.localhost -o dist/shopping-assistant-service.wasm

author: ymori-aka
